subject: general
question: On 12 September 2002, ISRO launched the Kalpana-1 satellite using the Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle. What is the application of this satellite?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Climate & environment communication**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kalpana-1 satellite** was launched by **ISRO **on **12 September 2002** using the** Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle**.
 
• Its primary application is in **climate and environment communication**.
 
• Kalpana-1 is named after **Kalpana Chawla**, the first woman of Indian origin in space.
 
• The satellite helps in **meteorological observations and data collection** related to weather and climate.
 
• It plays a crucial role in **disaster management** by providing vital data for forecasting and monitoring natural calamities like cyclones and floods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalpana-1** was originally known as** METSAT-1** before being renamed in honor of **Kalpana Chawla** after the Columbia disaster.
 
• It operates in the geostationary orbit and provides continuous monitoring of weather patterns over the Indian subcontinent.
 
• Data from Kalpana-1 supports various applications including **agriculture, water resources management, and aviation**.
 
• The satellite's instruments include a** Very High Resolution Radiometer (VHRR) and a Data Relay Transponder (DRT)**.
